summary.audit_scope: All 8 abstentions reviewed; representative covered/excluded cases inspected. No precision estimate because no confident candidates were emitted.

validation.incremental_result: Our own dependency-free Cargo fixture reproduced stale output without a file watch and rebuilding after adding it. This is not a corpus finding.

findings.evidence: Controls Kotlin output destination. This build.rs declares file watches but no env watches. The CLI sets this key from the Android project and package identifier.
findings.limits: Detector abstains because external helpers can emit watches. Source inspection is suggestive, but Android incremental build not executed and upstream rebuild triggers may cover common changes.

findings.evidence: Controls the destination of generated proguard-tauri.pro; no matching env watch appears in the build.rs. The CLI supplies this input.
findings.limits: Same helper/configuration uncertainty as the Kotlin path lead; no proven stale output on real Tauri.

findings.evidence: Substituted into the generated proguard configuration. Explicit file watchers in this source do not track this environment input.
findings.limits: CLI config changes may already cause other rebuilds; external helper effects and complete target build not checked. Group with the other two Android leads as one possible lifecycle issue, not three confirmed bugs.

findings.evidence: Dynamic env key is constructed as CARGO_FEATURE_<feature>. It is Cargo-managed; manually promoting this abstention would be wrong.
findings.detector_status: unknown dynamic input; not emitted as a candidate

findings.evidence: Reads file.path() while iterating the directory declared at line 300. The directory watch covers contents. Prototype cannot resolve the local env_var helper/path iteration, so it abstains.
findings.detector_status: unknown dynamic input; not emitted as a candidate

findings.evidence: __TAURI_WORKSPACE__ is a repository-private workaround flag supplied by .cargo/config.toml. Its missing direct watcher alone is weak evidence of a real user problem.
Local env_var(var) is called with multiple keys (Cargo manifest directory and WRY package/library). A generic variable-name read cannot be classified without propagating arguments.
findings.detector_status: unknown dynamic input; not emitted as a candidate

findings.evidence: The defs directory read is covered by the formatted directory watcher at line 21; file reads at line 39 are also paired with the same path binding watcher at line 38.
findings.detector_status: covered, including formatted .display() and lexical binding matching

findings.evidence: Cargo provides RUSTC_LINKER according to configured target linker. Treating every env::var without an env watcher as an omission would report this incorrectly.
File::open("assets/228_themes.json") is covered by the watch at line 32.

recommendation: Keep experimental. The sample yielded useful Tauri Android review leads but zero confirmed defects. A default warning needs helper-effect summaries and path/input tracking beyond direct literal reads; report abstentions separately instead of warning on all unknowns.
